subject: general
question: If each interior angle of a regular polygon is 144°, then the number of its sides is:
solution:
Given 

Each interior angle = 144° 

Formula used 

Each interior angle = 180(n - 2)/n (n = no. of sides) 

Calculation 

Each interior angle = 144° 

⇒ 180(n - 2) = 144n 

⇒ n = 10 

∴ The no. of side of polygon is 10.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ac24bef1d29c317f94f6a0cf2c3e0725b167629af806a77367a7ab72892a6db.png] 

Each interior angle = 144° 

The each exterior angle = 180 - 144 = 36° 

The number of sides = 360/36 = 10

∴ The no. of side of polygon is 10.
